kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Five new vents have now opened on and near the northwest wall of Halemaʻumaʻu crater and produced small lava flows. Spattering continues from the north vent, periodic bursts from south and west vents. Summit inflation is stalled, tremor is increasing.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
